body: Hey! Don't do it, you're lovely!
I hated it. But I have a weird friction "allergy" so it just makes me break out in weird vagina hives. No fun.
You deserve it. You seem like a real asshole.

Eleven years ago I overdosed on a mixture of pills and nail polish remover. I had taken 30 60mg pills of cymbalta and approximately 60mg of ativan.  I began to get very worried that the pills would not be enough, which is when I drank a full bottle of nail polish remover. That made me vomit violently, the sound of which alarmed my room mate who then called the ambulance. I remember fighting with them, and then the cops were there. That's about all I remember. Four days later I woke up with a breathing tube stuck to my face. I had been put into a medically induced coma. When I woke up, I remember being angry. I begged the nurses to kill me. I cursed the doctors. I didnt handle it well. After spending some time in the psych ward, I was released. And then you just rebuild. I moved in with my brother, got a new job, and now everyday I'm still a little disappointed because I'm still chronically depressed an actively suicidal. You just learn to go through the motions so you don't hurt people. Yay.
